acceptance: Record compliance and merge authorization are separate machine results; source-complete can be recorded but not merged.
A merge-ready claim without a trusted host store, a configured trust root or an exported signed proof is refused.
The pull-request gate uses the same phase scope function as the host entry; unapproved paths fail even when ownership resolves.
W16.console-ui-fixes carries the implementation and its two existing console test files in one owner scope, without granting tests/ui/ or a business root.
Source-check receipts must bind the checked bytes and cover the actual change.
CI checks the record and the merge authorization inside the existing validate job, from the base revision checker, with no actor exemption.

limitations.remoteEnforcement: The GitHub repository variable OPL_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORITY_PUBLIC_KEY is not configured and the hosted governance/validate jobs have not run; remote required-check state cannot be proven from this session.
limitations.bootstrap: This tool first lands here, so the base revision predates the checker: the hosted run for this pull request uses the head copy with an explicit bootstrap warning and is not fully enforced remotely. Later pull requests execute the base revision checker.
limitations.hostAcceptance: No host acceptance receipt exists for this branch yet. The development host must approve and verify a run at the candidate commit, export the signed proof and rewrite the body to merge-ready; the validate merge step fails until then.
limitations.scopedAdmission: This session is shell-enabled rather than a restricted worker; no opl.development.stage.v1 receipt is fabricated and no trusted store is deployed.
